notes.title: Fruits of Fury Patch #2
notes.notes:
Thank you for everyone who played and reviewed the game in the first week!

Here are the following changes based on player feedback:
- Reduced the bosses health and damage on their abilities
- Slightly increased exp gained per experience orb
- Fixed trunk slam hitbox being small
- Fixed a bug where if you pressed reroll powers when you didn't have enough money, it would increase the reroll cost
- Increased the legendary powerup chance to 10% up from 1%
- Made the Dragonfruit minions a little bit slower

notes.title: Fruits of Fury Patch Notes #1
notes.notes:
First I want to give thanks to everyone who bought the game and gave feedback and reviews!

I have made some small changes post launch to some immediate player feedback:

[list]
[*] Removed the falling fruit ear piercing sound completely

[*] Normalised other sounds so they aren't so loud and blast your ears out of no where

[*] Some small performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Fruits of Fury has been released!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Fruits of Fury has been released on Steam! It comes after a greatly successful demo where many players played enjoyed and gave feedback of the game.

Here are some of the major additions and changes that have been implemented since the demo:

[list]
[*] Completing challenges now unlocks gear which you can wear and wearing a set bonus gives you a powerful finishing move you can use on cooldown!

[*] The champion fruit boss Bobby The Banana has been added to the game

[*] New challenges for Bobby The Banana

[*] A new desert level

[*] The majority of previously locked abilities in the demo are now available which include levels 1-4 and their treasure chest bonuses you will find in game.

[*] Many more enemy events have been added to occur on countdown including Corn and Capsicum events

[*] The game has been scaled down to be 10 minutes with the boss being the apex of the run, if you defeat the boss you have one the run.

[*] Many many balance changes have been made to accommodate the shorter game time. Players will now find that the game starts faster and they will become powerful more quickly. Enemies are also much stronger and bosses are much much stronger.

[*] Various performance improvements including an Unreal Engine 5 version upgrade
[/list]

and many and more!

If you find any bugs or have any feedback message me on twitter @BabyFaceJamess

notes.title: Challenges are here! 🍉
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Patch notes:[/b][/h3]
Added the ability to complete challenges which will award prize money on completion. Challenges can be found in the Locker and then clicking on the challenges button to the left.

[h2]Challenge List:[/h2]
- Kill 1000 Enemies in a run
- Kill 5000 Enemies in a run
- Kill 10000 Enemies in a run
- Defeat Willie the Watermelon without getting hit by one of his small Fruit Rolls
- Defeat Willie the Watermelon without getting hit by one of his large Fruit Rolls
- Defeat Willie the Watermelon with Fruit Roll as your only ability
- Shatter Willie the Watermelon's stagger bar before he claps
- Shatter Willie the Watermelon's stagger bar within 4 seconds
- Finish a run (20 minutes)
- Finish a run without ever healing
- Finish a run without rerolling ability choices on level up
- Finish a run with only one ability active

With many many more to be added on full game release!

[h2]Other changes:[/h2]
- Decreased banana enemy health
- Decreased exp needed to level up after level 15
- You can hide the stat menu on the left by pressing tab, this was not obvious so I put a small text indicating that you can hide it

notes.title: The Steam page for Fruits of Fury is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423179/065542c58954272c9ce491447ea5b2e009e51c48.png[/img]

🍊🍌 FRUITS OF FURY IS NOW LIVE ON STEAM! 🍌🍊

Fruits of Fury aims to be the next advancement in the Bullethell Roguelike
(aka Survivorslike / BulletHeaven) genre bringing a set of known and loved mechanics, as well as a new array of features and ideas.

🍓 Time to cut through hordes of cute fruit minions using your abilities until you can survive long enough to step into the wrestling ring to face a fruit champion. Each minion has different behavior and events that can occur, making each run a new journey.

🍉 Each boss in Fruits of Fury is fully voice-acted, possessing their own personalities, and featuring a unique set of boss mechanics that will make every fight a memorable experience. No more bullet sponges!

🍍 With each victory and defeat, you will earn prize money that can be used to enhance your character or buy cosmetic gear pieces. You will notice their character getting stronger with each run.

🍒 Each ability has four levels, and with each level, its power increases or extra effects are added to the ability.

🍈 During the fully narrated story mode, you will meet, interact with, and fight the larger-than-life personalities that inhabit the professional wrestling promotion.

🍏 What is pro wrestling without the most exotic and outrageous ring gear to equip to your character?

🥥 The first of its kind to be created using the cutting edge technology of Unreal Engine 5.

and much more!
